questions.question: Who was the first woman President of India?
questions.rationale: Pratibha Patil became President in 2007. Indira Gandhi was the first woman Prime Minister (1966) — the exam's favourite swap.

questions.question: The first Indian Governor-General of independent India was:
questions.rationale: Mountbatten was the last British Governor-General (1947-48); C. Rajagopalachari was the first and only Indian to hold the office (1948-50) before it was abolished.

questions.question: Who was the first Indian to travel into space?
questions.rationale: Squadron Leader Rakesh Sharma flew aboard the Soviet Soyuz T-11 in 1984 and answered Indira Gandhi's question with 'Saare Jahan Se Achha'.

questions.question: The first Indian to win a Nobel Prize was:
questions.rationale: Tagore won the 1913 Literature Nobel for Gitanjali — the first non-European laureate. Raman took the sciences' first Indian Nobel in 1930.

questions.question: Who became the first woman Chief Minister of an Indian state?
questions.rationale: Sucheta Kripalani led Uttar Pradesh from 1963 to 1967. Sarojini Naidu was the first woman Governor (of a province, UP) — the paired trap.

questions.question: India's first sound film was:
questions.rationale: Ardeshir Irani's Alam Ara (1931) was the first Indian talkie. Raja Harishchandra (1913) was the first full-length Indian feature film — silent.

questions.question: Who won independent India's first individual Olympic gold medal?
questions.rationale: Shooter Abhinav Bindra won the 10 m air rifle gold at Beijing 2008. Jadhav took the first individual medal (bronze, 1952); Rathore the first individual silver (2004).

questions.question: The first Indian woman to climb Mount Everest was:
questions.rationale: Bachendri Pal summited in 1984, a year after India's fourth expedition put her on top. Santosh Yadav later became the first woman to climb Everest twice.

questions.question: India's first woman IPS officer was:
questions.rationale: Kiran Bedi joined the service in 1972. Anna Rajam Malhotra was the first woman IAS officer (1951) — the pair papers swap.

questions.question: India's first satellite, launched in 1975, was named after which mathematician-astronomer?
questions.rationale: ISRO's Aryabhata (1975) honoured the 5th-century author of the Aryabhatiya — a double-trap, since the name belongs to both the man and the machine.
